design_checks.claim: Hex grid renders with ships positioned
design_checks.notes: renderGrid() draws 20x20 hex grid; renderShip() draws ships from this.positions map with side indicators, design abbreviations, HP bars, speed labels; dead ships shown as debris

design_checks.claim: Click ship to select, show movement range
design_checks.notes: onCanvasClick detects ship clicks via getShipAtPixel; activateShipInteraction runs BFS from position limited by ship.speed; moveableHexes highlighted green; ship panel shows HP, shields, MP, weapons, accuracy

design_checks.claim: Click hex to move selected ship
design_checks.notes: onCanvasClick checks moveableHexes; executeMoveToHex validates distance via hexDistance(), updates position, logs move, re-activates interaction
executeFire() validates target not same side, has weapons, has targets in range via getTargetsInWeaponRange; calls processRound(); valid targets highlighted yellow on grid
spawnDamageNumber creates floating text at target position with absorption info; green for shields, red for hull; floats upward over 150 frames
spawnExplosion creates 22 red/orange particles with random velocities; renderLoop animates expand+fade over 60/150 frames; dead ships shown as debris markers
All moves, fire attempts, destructions logged to combatState.log; renderLog displays newest-first, color-coded (blue=move, yellow=fire, red=destruction); scrollable panel
doAutoResolve sets flag, repeatedly calls processRound() every 100ms via requestAnimationFrame; stops at victory/defeat; cancelable on second click; results in alert
doRetreat calls attemptRetreat for each attacker ship; formula clamp((own_speed/max_enemy_speed)*50+25, 0, 95) matches §28 exactly; retreated ships removed from combat

verification_result.notes: All 9 acceptance criteria verified against CombatScreen.ts and design docs. TypeScript compiles clean (0 errors). All 239 tests pass (0 failures). Architecture compliant: UI in src/ui/screens/, no DOM imports from game code. Design compliance confirmed: grid size 20x20 matches combat-mechanics.md, damage sequence shields→armor→hull matches combat-algorithm.md §11, retreat formula matches §28. Note: combat-algorithm.md §9 specifies hit chance multiplier ×10 but combat-engine task explicitly changed to ×5 — this is a documented design change, not an implementation error.
